title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.


Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.


Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.


Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.


Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the \"procure-to-pay\" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities



What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.


What we offer:

  • Health Insurance: SUL AMÉRICA – Family – no co-payment – Nationwide coverage (free monthly membership)
  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.
  • Private pension plan
  • Christmas gift card
  • Meal voucher
  • On-site meals
  • Pharmacy voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • Toys – children up to 12 years old
  • Bonuses based on goal achievement


Working Hours: Administrative Shift

Work Location: Av. Darcy Vargas, 325 - Santanésia - Piraí/ Rio de Janeiro

All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities. :)

title: Especialista em Design de Calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
  • Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!


Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado:


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

title: SAP Basis Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em Follow The Sun (FTS) no suporte a incidentes para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo ambientes SAP RISE .
  • Garantir integridade, disponibilidade e controles das instâncias SAP em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud).
  • Produzir relatórios e métricas para stakeholders, incluindo KPIs operacionais e SLAs de serviços em nuvem .
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas de grande porte que envolvam múltiplos times e ambientes SAP RISE e tradicionais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times EMIT , SAP e hyperscalers (AWS, Azure) para restauração de serviços em incidentes críticos.
  • Analisar requisitos técnicos para onboarding SAP RISE e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir documentação de padrões BASIS , incluindo arquiteturas SAP RISE e configurações específicas de cloud.
  • Construir e testar Proof of Concepts (PoCs) em ambientes SAP RISE e SAP BTP .
  • Executar atividades de administração de sistemas em:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP HANA Database
  • Implementar e manter monitoramento e alertas utilizando:
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP Cloud ALM
  • Realizar atividades recorrentes de manutenção, como:
  • RFCs
  • Perfis SAP
  • Limpeza de file systems
  • Login groups e load balancing
  • Atuar como owner na análise e resolução de problemas de plataforma , utilizando práticas estruturadas de problem management.
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Upgrades de sistemas
  • Enhancement Packs
  • Atualizações de serviços em nuvem
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura, incluindo DB, SO e hardware , em ambientes híbridos.

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.

The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.


RESPONSABILITIES

i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.

ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.

iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.

iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.

v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.

vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.

vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M&A transactions.

viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.

ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.


QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area

ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)

iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.

ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.

iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable


SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

Job Purpose:

You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design

  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.

  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

title: Designer de roupas
description:
Design de Produto (moda athleisure)

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Lifestyle) é o responsável estratégico por traduzir conceitos e ideias criativas em produtos técnicos viáveis e desejáveis. Atuando como o braço técnico da área de Estilo, sua missão é transformar os direcionamentos estéticos em especificações precisas, garantindo que a identidade da marca de Athleisure seja preservada desde o desenho inicial até o produto acabado. Ele atua como uma referência técnica, assegurando que cada peça de vestuário combine inovação estética com rigor funcional e comercial.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções.
  • Pesquisa Aplicada de Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de materiais e referências de mercado para viabilizar tecnicamente as tendências e comportamentos de consumo identificados.
  • Acompanhamento de Prototipagem: Atuar em parceria direta com as áreas de Produto, Modelagem e Sourcing, acompanhando ajustes, amostras e validações técnicas até a aprovação final das peças.
  • Interface de Viabilidade: Trabalhar de forma integrada com Comercial, Marketing e Produção para garantir que a tradução do design respeite a viabilidade técnica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.
  • Ajuste de Performance: Utilizar feedbacks de mercado e análises de performance das coleções para aplicar melhorias técnicas contínuas no desenvolvimento de novos produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada em design de produto ou posições técnicas em moda, com foco em sportswear ou athleisure.
  • Domínio Técnico Avançado: Profundo conhecimento em processos de desenvolvimento, construção de vestuário, materiais tecnológicos e leitura/execução de fichas técnicas detalhadas.
  • Vivência em Suprimentos: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e relacionamento técnico com fornecedores.
  • Habilidades de Tradução Criativa: Capacidade de converter conceitos abstratos em soluções de design comerciais e funcionais com rigor estético.
  • Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência em traduzir coleções de alta escala e múltiplas entradas sazonais.
  • Vivência em marcas de moda lifestyle que exijam alto nível de detalhamento técnico.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de estilo para viabilização de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de performance de produto para otimização do design.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.


What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.


Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:


We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work


Your Role and Responsibilities:  

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).

We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Machine Learning Engineer | About You

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you are responsible for turning complex data and business challenges into scalable, high‑impact AI solutions. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.


Machine Learning Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Develop and maintain scalable, reproducible machine learning pipelines across preprocessing, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.


Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
About us:


DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.


Audit & Compliance:

  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
  • Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer).

Inspection Oversight:

  • Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
  • Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Non-Conformance Management:

  • Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
  • Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.

Documentation & Records:

  • Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.

Training & Communication:

  • Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
  • Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
  • Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.


Work Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.


Educational:

High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.


Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.


Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes , nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.


É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Construir e conduzir planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.

Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Ser a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.

Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.

Cultura de Cliente

  • Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);

  • Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário de métricas SaaS (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;

Desejáveis

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS B2B;

  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
  • Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: WbD, Success Playbooks).


Diferenciais

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.

description:

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.
